_source: Stage 4 (Claude Code, 07.10; revised 07.10 after lexicon §5.19 + §6 „Product names RO”): the shape for /producten, the home's „Deze week op de toog” and the bestelbon (stage 5). `categories` = the sections of the canvas board Producten + BBQ & gourmet (D-13; the home's gourmet tag lives there, its page is a later stage); NL names = lexicon §2.2 / §4 / §5.15, RO = §6 „Product names RO” categories. `items` = the board's tags; NL names from the word bank §2.2 / §2.4 (search demand — NOT the confirmed assortment: Cowork replaces them from the owners' price list, stage 15), RO names = the §6 table verbatim. Colli Varken 1's line = its contents (§5.11 NL, §6 table RO; the old site's colli, [OBSERVED], to check with John). Mici's line = the lexicon's (§2.4 gloss NL, §6 product-card example RO — §5.19: „every cooking line [KOOKLIJN] except Mici”). price null = not in FACTS.md → the tag shows [PRIJS] / [PREȚ]; the old site's €45 / €10 stay out until the owners confirm them (FACTS „Known prices”). `week` = ids into `items`. Units: kg · pers · colli · stuk · liter. Stage 5 (Claude Code, 07.10, the bestelbon): the old site's other priced lines added from docs/data/old-site-catalogue.json [OBSERVED] 06.10 — NL names as the old site printed them (a „(…)” part becomes the line; colli lines = their contents), prices null (FACTS: the old prices wait for the owners), RO names/lines = lexicon §6 table verbatim (stage 5 revision, 07.10); three categories from the catalogue (tapas · warm · dessert, its NL/RO names). `min` = smallest order (gourmet/fondue „vanaf 2 personen”, docs/order-flow.md §4); `step` (optional) overrides the unit default of src/lib/order-core.js; `orderOnly` = sold through the bestelbon, not shown on /producten (the five other colli wait for /colli-vleespakketten, stage 10). Stage 9 revision (13.10): the RO cooking-line placeholder is [GĂTIRE] (lexicon §5.19 / §6), the NL one stays [KOOKLIJN]. Row 15a (Claude Code, 13.10): docs/data/price-list.json ([OWNER] 13.10, FACTS) poured in — prices and units of the 31 traiteur ids it shares with this file, the 20 new ids (NL / RO names as the file gives them) under tapas · warm · dessert, the traiteur rows in the brochure's order (tapas · hapjes · vleeshoofdgerechten · warme groenten · soep · broodjes · dessert); hapjes now per stuk; the seven vleeshoofdgerechten per portie (unit `portie`, the line „per portie van 200 g” / „porție de 200 g”); tapas schotels keep their persons as the line (RO with a hyphen). Still null → [PRIJS] / [PREȚ]: every per-kg row, mici, the six colli (not in the owners' list). Row 15 (Claude Code, 19.10, lexicon §5.30): the 15 per-kg rows keep `price` null with `priceInStore: true` (Dan 19.10 16:25: „prijs in de winkel”, no Offer); the six colli take the old site's prices, confirmed unchanged by the owners [OWNER] 19.10 (docs/data/owners-answers-2026-10-19.json `colli`). Row 15c (Claude Code, 19.10, lexicon §5.31): the 15 per-kg `line`s = the §5.19 cooking-line table, NL and RO 1:1 (approved by Dan 19.10 17:44, standard methods [PRACTITIONER] until the owners replace them); mici: the table line replaces the NL gloss on the tag (the gloss stays in faq.json and on /roemeense-specialiteiten). Row 18 (Claude Code, 20.10, D-41 · D-44): /producten shows every row of this file — the 15 per-kg rows as counter tags, the 60 others (colli · gourmet · tapas · warm · dessert, `orderOnly` included) as the cards of part 2 „Feest & traiteur”; `orderOnly` now only means „no counter tag” (its own page is row 10d). Pastrami's NL line shortened (lexicon §5.19 20.10); RO „burgeri” → „hamburgeri” in the Colli Porc 2 and Colli John lines (Dan 20.10). Row 18b (Claude Code, 20.10, D-47 · D-48): docs/data/owners-counter-list-2026-10-20.json poured as it is — 50 board rows (rund 19 · varken 23 · organ meats 8, `group` „organen”), each `priceInStore`, `board: true`, no line, `unit` · `step` · `min` per item (stuk 1/1 or kg 0,1/0,1); the five names merged with existing tags are not added; the 15 live tags take their class from `existing_tags_qty` (six per stuk). Row 21 (Claude Code, 23.10, D-50 (1)): docs/data/owners-counter-list-2026-10-22.json [OWNER] 22.10 poured as it is — 115 board rows (kip 14 · lam 11 · bereidingen 20 · marinades 25 · charcuterie 26 · roemeens 19), each `priceInStore`, `board: true`, no line, the file's `group`, `unit` · `step` · `min`, `orderOnly` where set (lam-half, lam-heel); the three new categories bereidingen · marinades · charcuterie after lam (NL/RO = lexicon §5.19 „23.10”); not added: the 5 rows whose `existing` names a live tag (kipfilet, kippenboutjes, kalkoengebraad, lamsbout, gerookte-worst) and the 7 `flag` rows (UNVERIFIED until Georgiana answers, form section 8); added: caltabos · toba · carne-la-garnita, which also stand in price-list.json ro-feest (two surfaces, one product). 125 + 115 = 240 rows. `categories[].groups` = the names of a board's groups (`items[].group`), NL/RO = lexicon §5.19 „23.10” (varken's organen: §5.19 „20.10 12:5x”); rows without a `group` sit under the category's own name; a board with one group shows no group label.
